title: KnownValueNondualGeneralizedConvex.lean

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Globally convex, continuously differentiable f: ℝ^d → ℝ with an attained global minimum; strong convexity is not assumed.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Each query returns the exact full Euclidean gradient, independently of history and seed.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: The same query also returns the exact function value; value and gradient constitute one oracle reply.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: For every x,y, ‖∇f(x)−∇f(y)‖₂ ≤ (L0 + L1 sup_{z∈[x,y]} ‖∇f(z)‖₂)‖x−y‖₂. L0,L1 are positive and public.

distinctive_assumptions.label: non_euclidean_geometry
distinctive_assumptions.details: Some global minimizer satisfies ‖x0−xstar‖₁ ≤ R, whereas smoothness uses Euclidean norms. R>0 is public; queries and output are unrestricted points of ℝ^d.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), with public positive integer d.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The exact global minimum value fstar is public, together with x0, d, L0, L1, R and ε. The objective and a minimizing point are hidden.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The returned point must satisfy f(output)−fstar ≤ ε, with public ε>0.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The objective-gap guarantee holds almost surely under the execution law, within the supplied fixed oracle budget; algorithmic randomization is permitted.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The formulation combines gradient-dependent Euclidean smoothness with an ℓ₁ distance bound to a global minimizer and public knowledge of the exact optimum value.

descriptionHtml:
Known-Value Generalized Convex Minimization

We consider minimizing a continuously differentiable convex function f:Rd→R, where d≥1. The function f is (L0,L1)-smooth in the Euclidean norm, with L0,L1>0. Its minimum value f⋆∈R is known, and a given point x0∈Rd lies within coordinate ℓ1 distance R>0 of a global minimizer. The oracle returns (f(x),∇f(x)) at x. For ε>0, the goal is an output x¯∈Rd satisfying f(x¯)−f⋆≤ε almost surely under P, the law of the algorithm’s randomness.

The optimization problem is minx∈Rdf(x). We write ∥⋅∥2 for the Euclidean norm and ∥v∥1=∑i=1d|vi| for the coordinate ℓ1 norm. The algorithm receives d, L0, L1, R, ε, f⋆, and x0.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Convexity). For every x,y∈Rd and t∈[0,1], f((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)f(x)+tf(y).

Assumption 2 (Generalized smoothness). The function f is differentiable everywhere, and ∇f is continuous. For every x,y∈Rd, ∥∇f(x)−∇f(y)∥2≤(L0+L1supz∈[x,y]∥∇f(z)∥2)∥x−y∥2,[x,y]={(1−t)x+ty:t∈[0,1]}.

Assumption 3 (Known minimum and initial distance). There exists x⋆∈Rd such that f(x⋆)≤f(x)for every x∈Rd,f(x⋆)=f⋆,∥x0−x⋆∥1≤R.

Queries may be made at any point of Rd, with each query returning both the exact function value and the exact gradient. After the allotted oracle calls, the output must satisfy f(x¯)−f(x⋆)≤εP-a.s.

import LongTails.Template
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Gradient.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.Function
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2

open scoped BigOperators

namespace LongTails.Setups.KnownValueNondualGeneralizedConvex

open OracleTemplate

structure Public where
  d : ℕ
  L0 : ℝ
  L1 : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  fstar : ℝ
  x0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Public
  Public := Public
  Instance p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d) → ℝ
  Query p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
  Reply p := ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
  Output p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
  publicInput p := p
  valid p := 0 < p.d ∧ 0 < p.L0 ∧ 0 < p.L1 ∧ 0 < p.R ∧ 0 < p.ε
  admissible p f O :=
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f ∧
    (∀ x, HasGradientAt f (gradient f x) x) ∧
    Continuous (gradient f) ∧
    (∀ x y, ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤
      (p.L0 + p.L1 * sSup ((fun z => ‖gradient f z‖) '' segment ℝ x y)) * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∀ k seed x, O.answer k (0, x) seed = (f x, gradient f x)) ∧
    (∃ xstar, IsMinOn f Set.univ xstar ∧ f xstar = p.fstar ∧
      ∑ i, |p.x0 i - xstar i| ≤ p.R)
  successful p f output P :=
    ∃ xstar, IsMinOn f Set.univ xstar ∧ f xstar = p.fstar ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂(P : MeasureTheory.Measure _), f (output ω) - f xstar ≤ p.ε

end LongTails.Setups.KnownValueNondualGeneralizedConvex
